limitations: 10 fictional cases, one observed ingestion each; two additional identical intake samples measure consistency only
Prospect confirmation judged as initial disposition; human approval continuation not run
No real attachments, transport authentication, bank matching, live sends/filings or downstream completion
Custom taxes/fees/legal assumptions not independently verified by a company secretary
No before/after matched run: fresh holdout cannot quantify improvement against previous different emails
No false-positive draft guard in these five drafts does not eliminate previously observed benign heading false positives
No unsafe intake proposal means recall cannot be estimated; high consistency/self-reported confidence is not correctness
